title: Biphasic bone substitutes coated with PLGA incorporating therapeutic ions Sr2+ and Mg2+: cytotoxicity cascade and in vivo response of immune and bone regeneration
authors: Ren Y, Jung O, Batinic M, Burckhardt K, Görke O, Alkildani S, Köwitsch A, Najman S, Stojanovic S, Liu L, Prade I, Barbeck M. Front Bioeng Biotechnol. 2024 Jun 24;12:1408702.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “, this study delved into the repercussions of therapeutic ion doping on bone regeneration patterns and inflammatory responses, offering insights for the advancement of a new generation of bip hasic calcium phosphate materials with potential clinical applicability” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
